title: Gradient Descent
description: Animates gradient descent on the parabola y = x². A red dot starts at x = 3.0 and iteratively moves toward the minimum using a learning rate of 0.15. Each of the 5 steps displays a yellow gradient arrow showing descent direction, along with a text label reporting the current x, gradient, and loss. Ends with a "Reached Minimum!" label in green.

learning_rate.description: Step size multiplier for each gradient update

start_x.description: Initial x-position of the descending point

steps.description: Number of gradient descent iterations (loop count)

what_to_modify: You can change the learning_rate, start_x, number of steps, the function (e.g. x³ − 3x), colors of the dot or arrows, add a loss-over-time subplot, or show the gradient value as a dynamic label.
